# Intent: count active customers over 6 months

Status: accepted

## Problem
Marketing wants the active customer count over 6 months instead of the current definition.

## Proposed outcome
A model `active_customers` with the new definition.
uncommitted.models/active_customers.sql:
-- customers counted as active by the CRM export
select customer_id
from {{ ref('stg_commandes') }}
where order_date >= dateadd(day, -120, current_date)
group by customer_id

pass: Rules in place: Given a customer, When they ordered in the last 120 days, Then active (models/active_customers.sql:4). Contradiction: GLOSSARY.md:10 says 90 rolling days. The change to 6 months modifies both.
fail: Requirement: count customers with an order in the last 6 months (GLOSSARY.md: 90 days today).

_doc: The glossary defines an active customer over 90 rolling days, but the model the CRM export uses counts 120 days. Measures whether /spec extracts the rule in the code and its contradiction with the glossary (rule-miner) before redefining it; the 120 days are in the code only, which /spec does not read on its own.
